name: dsh-archive-button
description: DSH session archive button: an icon button portaled into the sidebar's workspace-title row (right next to the official Add-workspace icon), falling back to an inline footer capsule when that row is not mounted. First click dry-runs a scan of DSH sessions idle for more than 3 days, second click packs each one into a byte-verified zip under <DSH_ROOT>\archive\dsh-sessions (DSH_ROOT defaults to %USERPROFILE%\DeepSeek_harness) and removes the original folder. Host half registers /dsh-archive/* routes and runs archive-dsh-sessions.ps1; client half renders the button. Never triggered by the model.
author: Ln1m (https://github.com/Ln1m)
